description: Mississippi River Basin Drought & Water Dashboard is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA, National Integrated Drought Information System; NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information; UNCA's National Environmental Mapping and Applications Center (NEMAC). When drought occurs in the Mississippi River Basin, it can have devastating impacts. To support drought communications and decision-making in the region, NOAA’s National Integrated Drought Information System (NIDIS) and partners throughout the basin built the Mississippi River Basin Drought and Water Dashboard. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Economy, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
